purpose: Parent-residue normalized single-protein-chain benchmark input: only non-glycan HYP/OCS converted to PRO/CYS; exact glycans retained; original experimental reference remains chemically modified.

ccd_companion.geometry: official CCD ideal only, not benchmark coordinates

conventions.protein_positions: 1-based full canonical query sequence; never author residue numbering
conventions.atom_names: exact wwPDB CCD atom IDs, including five-character CCD codes
conventions.residue_units: one glycan node is one CCD monosaccharide; within-residue bonds are in ccd_components
conventions.inter_residue_bonds: explicit named atom pairs in glycan bonds and protein attachment; branch inferred only from these edges
conventions.reaction: construct CCD heavy atoms, remove per-node heavy leaving atoms, add explicit inter-residue bonds; discard explicit dictionary hydrogens and recompute after assembly
conventions.stereochemistry: CCD identity and atom stereo_config preserve component identity; preserve local chirality during substituent replacement, do not blindly reapply pre-reaction CIP labels to assembled molecules
conventions.observations: node observed_atom_names records one selected reference visibility only, not all equivalent experimental copies; complete chemical identity comes from CCD; no target coordinates
conventions.msa_join: exact msa_query.sequence_id and full sequence_sha256; method-specific MSA provenance required
conventions.anonymisation: existing GPSEQ query IDs retained; GLYCO case IDs derive from chemistry; no PDB/author numbering or target coordinates
conventions.parent_residue_condition: parent_residue_non_glycan_PTM_removed_20261104; source-case mapping and removed PTM atoms recorded in separate CASE_ID_MAP; no target coordinates.
